items.title: Add the two missing runtime-artifact ignore patterns to REQUIRED_RUNTIME_IGNORE_LINES in canonical order
items.context:
Edit only `scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs` line 15 area's `REQUIRED_RUNTIME_IGNORE_LINES` array. Two insertions, in canonical registry order:
  1. `'**/owner-lease.json',` immediately after `'**/activity.jsonl',`
  2. `'.koala/locks/',` immediately after `'.koala/traces/',`
Resulting list = 14 items, byte-equal to `listRuntimeArtifactIgnorePatterns()` output (verified live: `node -e "import('./packages/main/dist/core/runtime-artifact-registry.js').then(m => console.log(m.listRuntimeArtifactIgnorePatterns()))"`). Do NOT change other lines, do NOT restructure, do NOT touch any other file. After the edit, the assertion at verify-entrypoints.mjs:555 (the no-churn `koala init` test) and the byte-equality assertion at :557 both pass.
